title: Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2003, Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2003, Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
